Exceptions: Fire Alarms

Try the risk, catch the species, finally cleans. Never nap through alarms.

⏱ 16 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Try, catch by species, clean

throw shouts; throws warns.

🚨

Wedding bouncers. TRY hosts; CATCH ushers each crasher-species out; FINALLY cleans no matter what. Empty catch = nap through the fire.

ProgramRead each line in order
try {
  int age = Integer.parseInt("18"); // risky: text to number
  System.out.println("Age " + age);
} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
  System.out.println("Type digits please!"); // plan B
} finally {
  System.out.println("Done checking"); // ALWAYS runs
}
// With "abc" instead: plan B prints, finally still runs.

"18" sails through; "abc" diverts to plan B; finally always speaks.
